integrity: Proof uses exact high-temperature ring expansion and strict concavity; independent audit not performed.
limitations: Exactly three equal-magnitude negative bonds on zero-field classical 1D Ising ring; only temperature-rescaled static susceptibility at t in (0,1] and positional ordering; no physical beta-weighted susceptibility, dynamics, or unequal couplings. Non-exhaustive historical originality review.
title: Three-defect frustration: an exact thermal susceptibility product and optimal spacing on Ising rings
